Lemonade For One
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 1:31pm

Ingredients




1 Lemon
2 tablespoons Sugar
3/4 cup Ice water
Crushed ice

Preparation

1 Squeeze lemon and set aside. Put sugar in a glass. Add ice water, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Add lemon juice and pour over crushed ice. 2 OPTIONAL: Soda water may be used as an alternative to water if desired.
